name: Tilde.run (discontinued)

modes.label: Discontinued container sandbox (was private preview; never priced; shut down 2026-07)
modes.note: No rates ever published. Founder on HN (2026-05-06): pricing 'will very likely be based on consumption'. Product was free private preview ('Free to start') with admin-approved signups; shut down ~2026-07-01 and folded into lakeFS Mount. Cannot be priced; kept for completeness.

plans.name: Private preview (free, discontinued)
plans.note: 'Free to start - join the private preview'; signups pending admin approval 24-48 h. Service no longer available (tilde.run redirects to lakeFS shutdown post).

caveats: DISCONTINUED: lakeFS announced 'We recently shut down tilde.run' on 2026-07-01; tilde.run, /pricing and docs.tilde.run redirect to that post. Work moved into lakeFS Mount (enterprise lakeFS).
No pricing was ever published: at launch (Show HN 2026-05-06) the founder said they had no pricing answer yet; a /pricing nav link appeared by 2026-06-11 but no content was ever archived.
snapshot 'fs' = versioned lakeFS repository commits of the mounted /sandbox data, not container/VM snapshots; container root filesystem is ephemeral.
Isolation is a container with all Linux capabilities dropped + per-sandbox network namespace and default-deny egress proxy; runtime and host region undisclosed.
Per-sandbox CPU/RAM limits, runtime caps and concurrency never published.
Discontinued: empty sizes prevents accidental zero-price selection even with beta/alt enabled.

Discontinued: lakeFS blog "We recently shut down tilde.run" (published 2026-07-01, updated 2026-09-17; https://lakefs.io/blog/we-recently-shut-down-tilde-run/, checked 2026-09-28). Mode and plan flagged legacy so it is never priced; kept only as a record.

fleet.notes: Discontinued, confirmed by official lakeFS July 1, 2026 shutdown announcement. No new self-serve fleet at any size. Historic 24–48h preview approval is not a current quota turnaround; successor lakeFS Mount is a different product.
